about: Plan 7.2 / W10.E33: what the Buildkite real-model steps run, pinned by digest. A model by its Ollama manifest digest (`ollama show <model> --modelfile` / the registry manifest), an image by its content digest (`docker buildx imagetools inspect <image>`), never a tag. A pin still reading PIN-ON-THE-MAC fails the step (npm run ci:real-model-pins -- check): fill it on the Mac, where the registry is reachable. The model cache is keyed by the digest, so a new build of a model is a new cache.
